notes: FIELD MEANINGS (read before bumping anything): `upstream` is the fork base the Dockerfile FROMs -- a PRIVATE GHCR package pulled only by the authenticated build workflow; keep it in lockstep with apps/infra/openclaw/Dockerfile's FROM line, which is hardcoded and has no build-arg templating. `image`/`tag`/`full` are the LEGACY PUBLIC upstream image, kept only as the bootstrap/unknown-env fallback in container-stack.ts (pulled by per-user ECS tasks with NO registry credentials, so it must stay anonymously pullable). `extendedImage` + per-env dev.tag/prod.tag are the ECR extended image actually deployed; dev.tag/prod.tag are the per-environment promotion gate (flip dev, validate, then prod). CONFIG DEFAULTS PINNED IN THE SAME PR (NOT new in stable -- both shipped in beta.3 and are already live): agents.defaults.maxConcurrent pinned to 4 because 8.1 replaced the fixed DEFAULT_AGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT = 4 with min(16, max(8, availableParallelism)); the max(8,...) is a floor so 1 vCPU cannot resolve below 8, and availableParallelism() honours cpuset but NOT the CFS quota Fargate uses, so our tasks read the HOST core count and land on 16. memory.search.rememberAcrossConversations pinned false because 8.1 derives it from session.dmScope rather than a literal default. dev.tag AND prod.tag ARE DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED HERE, both staying on 2026.8.1-isol8.1-d01f9e0.
